test_timelimit_wrapper_close: test that closing a TimeLimit-wrapped LlvmEnv sets the service to None
test_timelimit_wrapper_fork_type: test that forking a TimeLimit-wrapped environment returns a TimeLimit instance
test_timelimit_multistep: test that a TimeLimit-wrapped environment supports multistep actions and tracks benchmark and actions
test_timelimit_custom_observation_spaces: test that a TimeLimit-wrapped environment supports custom observation spaces like IrInstructionCount
test_timelimit_truncation: test that TimeLimit sets done and TimeLimit.truncated after exceeding max_episode_steps
